activity.notes: After Sancho II's death, García II briefly recovered the Galician kingship before Alfonso VI imprisoned him. ATLAS preserves this restored reign as a second Activity instead of flattening the interruption into one continuous rule.

sources.title: García II de Galicia — Consello da Cultura Galega
sources.citation_text: The Consello da Cultura Galega identifies García II as King of Galicia in two separate periods, 1065-1071 and 1072-1073.
